description: Estimate a PostgreSQL cursor plan by default. With analyze=true, ask the user to confirm before executing the SELECT to measure actual rows and timing. A client with MCP form elicitation is required for ANALYZE. Pass one SELECT with optional scalar $1... parameters, not an EXPLAIN statement. Requires a dedicated accessMode=data_read source. Plan expressions are hidden. Cursor planning and the data-reader role can differ from the application plan.
name: explain_database_query
